title: Database connection saturation
content: PostgreSQL database connection pool exhausted, slow SQL queries, locks, long transactions, replication lag and storage pressure.
steps: Inspect database connection counts and pool saturation against configured limits.
Review slow queries and active locks; identify long-running transactions.
Compare the incident timeline with recent deployments before proposing a reviewed mitigation.

title: Kubernetes pod restart investigation
content: Kubernetes pods CrashLoopBackOff OOMKilled ImagePullBackOff pending deployment replicas, readiness probes, memory limits, node capacity.
steps: Inspect pod events, restart counts, and the last termination reason.
Compare memory usage with container limits and check readiness probe failures.
Review previous container logs and the deployment diff with the platform on-call engineer.

title: Network and TLS connectivity checks
content: DNS resolution timeout, TLS certificate expiry, HTTPS handshake, firewall, network packets dropped, load balancer upstream health.
steps: Check DNS resolution and the affected hostname from the same network as the service.
Inspect certificate expiry and hostname coverage; compare firewall and routing changes.
Review upstream health checks and packet loss before proposing a network change.

title: Application error regression investigation
content: Application API HTTP 500 internal server error, Python exception traceback TypeError KeyError, checkout code release regression.
steps: Correlate request failures with sanitized application stack traces.
Compare the error timeline with the most recent code release and configuration changes.
Reproduce the failing request in staging and request review of a rollback if appropriate.

title: Suspicious identity activity review
content: Security unauthorized authentication login attempts, IAM role permission escalation, suspicious account access, leaked secret API credential token.
steps: Preserve relevant audit events without copying credentials into incident notes.
Review the principal, source, affected permissions, and authentication timeline.
Escalate to the security on-call engineer for approved containment and credential rotation.
